name: mixtools
description: Mix and master songs in Ardour with Claude: import tracks, change levels, pans, effects and sends, bounce, measure, compare before and after, and render release-ready masters for streaming.
long_description: Mixtools lets Claude act as a mix engineer for someone who is not an audio engineer. It drives Ardour through Ardour's built-in MCP server, renders bounces with Ardour's command-line exporter, and measures them (loudness, peaks, stereo, frequency balance) so Claude can explain what it hears in numbers and check every change. It masters finished mixes for streaming with a true-peak limiter and checks masters against distributor and streaming targets. Requires the Ardour build distributed with mixtools.

tools.name: mixtools_status
tools.description: Check Ardour, its MCP server, the open song, and the workspace folders.

tools.name: song_new

tools.name: song_open

tools.name: snapshot_save
